title: White — opening traps
blurb: Tempting-looking replies that lose on the spot. You spring these as White.

traps.name: Légal's Mate
traps.idea: Sacrifice the queen with Nxe5; if Black takes it, Bxf7+ and Nd5 is a model mate.

traps.name: Fried Liver Attack
traps.idea: Ng5 already hits f7. After 5…Nxd5, the knight sac 6.Nxf7! forks queen and rook and drags the Black king into the open for a raging attack.

traps.name: Caro-Kann Smothered Mate (Qe2)
traps.idea: 5.Qe2 quietly pins the e-file. After …Ngf6, Nd6# is mate — …exd6 is illegal because the e7-pawn is pinned to the king.

traps.name: Monticelli Trap
traps.idea: Ignore the knight: 10.Ng5! double-attacks h7 and the b7-bishop at once, and White comes out the exchange ahead with a winning bind.

traps.name: Tennison Gambit Trap
traps.idea: The quiet 6.Nxf7! Kxf7 7.Bg6+!! Kxg6 8.Qxd8 nets the queen — the bishop check deflects the king clean off the d-file.

traps.name: Danish Gambit Trap
traps.idea: Both bishops rake the kingside. After 6.Bxd5 Nf6??, 7.Bxf7+! Kxf7 8.Qxd8 snares the queen.

title: Black — opening traps
blurb: Gambits and counter-traps where a greedy or natural White move loses. You spring these as Black.

traps.name: Kieninger Trap (Budapest)
traps.idea: The early …Qe7 pins White’s e-pawn. When White grabs the bishop, …Nd3 is a smothered mate — exd3 is illegal.

traps.name: Lasker Trap (Albin Countergambit)
traps.idea: The Albin’s advanced d-pawn enables an underpromotion: …exf2+ then …fxg1=N+! wins, since after the knight is taken …Bg4+ skewers the queen.

traps.name: Englund Gambit Trap
traps.idea: After 6.Bc3 Bb4! the bishop is pinned; 7.Qd2 Bxc3 8.Qxc3 Qc1# is a back-rank smothered mate.

traps.name: Mortimer Trap (Ruy Lopez)
traps.idea: The odd-looking 4…Ne7 invites 5.Nxe5?? c6! 6.Bc4 Qa5+! — a check that forks the king and the stranded e5-knight.

traps.name: From's Gambit Trap
traps.idea: Against From’s Gambit, 4.Nc3?? Qh4+ 5.g3 Qxg3+! 6.hxg3 Bxg3# is a classic smothered-style mate down the dark squares.

traps.name: Stafford Gambit Trap
traps.idea: The Stafford bites back: 6.Bg5?? Nxe4! 7.Bxd8 Bxf2+ 8.Ke2 Bg4# — the greedy queen grab walks into mate.

traps.name: Noah's Ark Trap (Ruy Lopez)
traps.idea: The …c5–c4 pawn roll boxes in the b3-bishop: with a-, c- and own pawns covering its squares, it has nowhere to go and is lost.

traps.name: Elephant Trap (Queen’s Gambit Declined)
traps.idea: If White grabs on d5, …Nxd5! works: after Bxd8, …Bb4+ wins the bishop back with interest and Black ends a clean piece up.

traps.name: Siberian Trap (Smith-Morra)
traps.idea: In the Smith-Morra, …Ng4 sets the trap: 9.h3?? Nd4! 10.Nxd4?? Qh2# — the queen swings to h2 with the g4-knight guarding it.
